correctness.rationale: A proper common prefix/suffix cannot contain both ones because identical two-marker alignment would force the suffix offset to zero. Zero-only borders contribute at most min(a,c); one-marker border uniquely has length a+c+1 and occurs precisely for b>=max(a,c), with full endpoint cases including n=2. Counting disjoint gap regions yields explicit integer interval A_n(t) and asymmetric/diagonal D_n(t); the enumerator splits into geometric sums H1+H2. Piecewise counts N_n(t)=n f(t/n)/2+O(1) uniformly in t and normalization C(n,2) establish uniform O(1/n) local limit and integrated moments. Inspect original verifier KMP prefix-function test on every two-one word 2<=n<=90, GF coefficients to m<=35, selected n<=2000 checks, but do not replace proof by finite tests.
